title: Carved in stone
notes: Every sky has its own stone: barnacled sea-stone, brass and clockwork, red sandstone, wind-scoured granite, ice, obsidian and star-marble.
Every menu is carved stone now: pause, the fall, the summit card, options, the leaderboard, achievements, the story and the skies list, with painted stars and ember plaques.
The summit lights a painted pillar of light and painted starbursts; ordinary perfects are a soft glint, the full burst saved for keystones and every fifth in a streak.
